apply_spectral_norm: apply spectral norm to a PyTorch module to constrain its weight matrix spectral radius
compute_spectral_weight: compute spectrally normalized weight using power iteration on a module's weight matrix
remove_spectral_norm: remove spectral norm from a PyTorch module and restore the original weight parameter
create_spectral_norm_class: create a SpectralNorm object with configurable power iterations, dimension, epsilon, and norm target
test_spectral_norm_module: test spectral norm application on a PyTorch module during training and evaluation modes
